gov_strip: A digital agriculture initiative · Government of Tamil Nadu (demo)
advisory_1: Water tomato and potato at the base, never overhead — wet leaves invite blight.
advisory_2: Check the undersides of leaves weekly; most diseases are visible there first.
advisory_3: Clear and destroy crop debris after harvest — it is where most fungal disease overwinters.
landing_hero_en: Your crop's leaf already knows what's wrong. We help you read it.
landing_hero_sub: Photograph a leaf and get an AI-checked diagnosis, with treatment advice pulled from a maintained agricultural reference — never invented by a model — in the language you speak at home.
landing_step1_body: Open the app on any phone and point the camera at the affected leaf. No account, no form to fill in first — capture works even with no signal, and the photo waits on your device until it can send.
landing_step2_body: A model trained on real plant-disease photographs checks the leaf against diseases it has learned to recognise, and says plainly how confident it is — including when it genuinely isn't sure.
landing_step3_body: No model here is allowed to invent pesticide dosages. Every recommendation is pulled from a maintained agricultural reference and shown to you in Tamil or English, never generated on the spot.
landing_step4_body: Your report — with no name attached — joins every other one on a live map, so an official can see an outbreak taking shape before it reaches the next field.
landing_closing_body: It takes one photograph. The diagnosis, the advice, and the map afterwards are already built.
landing_closing_cta_secondary: I'm an official — open the dashboard
landing_footer_note: Built for Tamil Nadu farmers and the officials who support them. Free to use, with no account required.
